description: Agent Travel: submit one travel booking with the travel authorization behind it: optionally the traveler with an id and name; the authorization with its id, the approver, when it was approved, its currency, the most the booking may cost, the first and last travel dates approved, the cabins or classes approved (economy, premium economy, business or first), its purpose and the authorization as written; and the booking with its reference, when it was made, who booked it, its currency, what it cost in all and each flight, rail, hotel, car or other segment with its id, kind, from and to, departure and arrival with their offsets, carrier, number, the cabin booked and its price. The signed report gives the authorization, the booking, the booked total against the cap with its share and any amount over, every segment’s dates read by day against the approved window, every flight or rail cabin against the highest cabin approved, and the approval with whether it came before the booking and whether the approver is the traveler or the booking agent, and counts them, and names a booking over its authorization: a total over the cap, a segment outside the approved dates, a cabin above the approved cabins and a booking made before the approval; then a total at 95% or more of the cap, a booking in another currency and an approver who is the traveler or the booking agent, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No cap, no booked total, no approved dates, no approved cabins for a flight or rail segment or no approver leaves the booking unverified. This reads one booking against the authorization behind it: whether a buyer identity on a purchase receipt is the delegating party is wever_delegated-identity-check, a proposed action against a policy text is wever_policy-fit-check and the amount bands an approver covers are wever_approval-chain-check. Verdict travel_authorization_over, travel_authorization_partial, travel_authorization_unverified or travel_authorization_within. POST /api/travel-authorization-check. Reads the travel records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment, booking or external write. Agent Travel reads a travel purchase an agent made, after the fact, from the traveler’s own records: the booking against the travel authorization, the itinerary against the trip as requested, the passenger details against the traveler’s ID, the fare rules against what the buyer was told, a change and a cancellation against the fare rules, the extras against what was authorized and needed, and a disruption against the carrier’s stated policy. Beside it, the Sports Trips tools such as wever_sports-trip-status plan, book and read a trip held on Wever, while a travel check reads a purchase made anywhere against its own records; wever_delegated-authority issues and reads the grant itself, while the authorization check reads one booking’s price, dates and class against the travel authorization behind it; and the Tokenized Asset Purchase checks such as wever_tokenized-quote-check read a tokenized asset purchase, while a travel check reads a travel booking. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-travel-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-travel/.

approved_at.description: When it was approved, such as 2026-12-02T08:15-05:00.

currency.description: A currency code, such as USD.

price_cap.description: The most the booking may cost, in the currency above.

window_end.description: The last travel date approved, such as 2026-12-02.

window_start.description: The first travel date approved, such as 2026-12-02.

booked_at.description: When the booking was made, such as 2026-12-02T08:15-05:00.

currency.description: A currency code, such as USD.

segments.description: Each flight, rail, hotel, car or other segment.

arrives.description: A date or time with its offset, such as 2026-12-02T08:15-05:00.

cabin.description: The cabin or class booked, for a flight or rail segment.

departs.description: A date or time with its offset, such as 2026-12-02T08:15-05:00.

total.description: What the booking cost in all.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.
